name: deepdive-cpq
description: DD CPQ skills and the DD CPQ connector, in one plugin. Skills update themselves from the repo; the connector is the hosted DD CPQ MCP server.

plugins.name: dd-quoting-agent
plugins.description: For sales reps: an autonomous quoting colleague. It plans the whole job (new quotes, multi-site ramps, renewals, upgrades, fitting a budget, fixing expiring quotes), prices every step with the DD CPQ engine, asks once, runs it, checks the cart and reports. Shortcuts: /quote, /intake, /send-check, /scenario, /fit, /amend, /renew, /golive, /sweep, /prep, /my-day, /renewals, /approvals, /setup.

plugins.name: dd-deal-desk
plugins.description: For deal desk analysts, renewal managers and pricing admins: runs the jobs that take hours. Reviews a quote against policy before it is signed or sent, and works across many quotes and contracts. Reviews change nothing; jobs that change records show one plan, get one yes, run and report.

plugins.name: dd-cpq
plugins.description: Every DD CPQ skill (rule authoring, quoting, bundles, rate plans, testing, dev workflow) and the DD CPQ connector, which signs you in to Salesforce as yourself.
